ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Mar-22-2005 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for OSC hearing for Change of Names of petitioner Yan Mei Liu and Jia Xin Chen, a Minor.
Commissioner: Sue Kaplan, Clerk: E. Estacio, CSR: JoAnn Prior
Petitioner: Jia Ying Chen, present in pro per as Guardian ad Litem with the Minor: Jia Xin Chen, also present was Jin Tian Chen, father. Parties were sworn and examined.

No objections to the proposed change of name were made at the hearing.
It appears to the satisfaction of the Court that all the allegations in the petition are true, correct, and sufficient and that the petition should be granted.

The Court grants the petition for Change of Name of Yan Mei Liu to CAROL YANMEI LIU and change of name of a Minor to: TINA JIAXIN CHEN.
Decree signed in open court.
